name: Giant Crocolisk Skin
summary: In the Wetlands, giant crocolisks yield thick hides that Menethil Harbor tradesmen need for leatherworking. Taking one is perilous work, and more than one hunter has been maimed.

sections.title: A Dangerous Trade
sections.body: The Wetlands' bogs and waterways shelter enormous crocolisks with hides dense enough to resist the marsh's damp rot. In Menethil Harbor, artisans such as James Halloran rely on steady shipments of skins to make rugged leather goods. Reaching a full-grown giant crocolisk means braving deep water and facing a fierce swamp predator, so every hide comes hard-won.

sections.title: The Apprentice's Folly
sections.body: Halloran's young apprentice once gathered the thick skins. Without the skill to defeat full-grown marsh beasts, the boy was ambushed along the northern coast. Giant crocolisks mauled him, and he now lies in a local midwife's care. She says he might pull through. After the attack, Halloran hired seasoned adventurers to hunt the predators and secure the skins he needs.

faq.q: What are Giant Crocolisk Skins used for?
faq.answer: James Halloran, a tradesman in Menethil Harbor, uses Giant Crocolisk Skins to make sturdy leather goods that can endure the marshlands' damp climate.

faq.q: Where are the crocolisks found that provide these skins?
faq.answer: Giant Wetlands Crocolisks roam the coast and inland marsh waters north of Menethil Harbor, in the shallows beyond local murloc settlements.
Halloran sent his apprentice alone to gather skins in the marsh. Giant crocolisks mauled the boy, and he now lies in a Menethil midwife's care. She says he might pull through.

faq.q: How do these skins compare to young crocolisk skins?
faq.answer: Young crocolisks yield thinner, more pliable skins. Full-grown giant crocolisks yield thicker, tougher hides, but killing one takes seasoned combat skill.

angles.text: As a hunter, stalking giant crocolisks along the coastline tests your skill at tracking aquatic beasts and keeping clear of the marsh waters.
